item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch group strikes against Ukrainian logistics facilities
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch group strikes against Ukrainian logistics facilities and vessels, used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 During the day, air-based high-precision weapons and attack drones hit the following targets: ▪️ the Eridon logistics centre in Vishnevoye of Kiev region, used for storage and distribution of military cargo; ▪️ the FM Logistik Dnepr logistics centre near Dudarkov of Kiev region, where warehouses were used to store dual-purpose goods as well as components of unmanned aerial vehicles; ▪️ the logistics centre in Korchevatoye of Kiev region, where cargo for the Armed Forces of Ukraine was stored and distributed; ▪️ a dry cargo ship with military equipment for the AFU in the port of Chernomorsk; ▪️ a dry cargo with weapons and ammunition in the Black Sea waters; ▪️ depots with military hardware in the port of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚩 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 🚩 As a result of resolute actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces took control over Kazachya Lopan in Kharkov region. 📍 Russian troops inflicted losses on formations of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Novoaleksandrovka, Prikolotnoye, Posredneye, and Sosnovy Bor of Kharkov region. 💥 In Sumy region, the Group's units engaged manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade near Ulanovo, Khoten, and Malaya Rybitsa (Sumy region). ▪️ The enemy lost more than 200 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one counter-fire radar station. 🚩 As a result of intensive actions, units of the Zapad Group of Forces liberated the city of Svyatogorsk in the Donetsk People's Republic. 🔥 Currently, the city is being mopped up from the Ukrainian militants hiding in basements. Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade near Studenok (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, Mayaki, Sidorovo, Krymki, and Prishib (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The enemy losses amounted to more than 205 troops, one U.S.-made HMMWV armoured vehicle, 20 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun. 📍 The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29174

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
As a result of resolute actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces took control over Kazachya Lopan in Kharkov region.
📍
Russian troops
inflicted losses
on formations of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Novoaleksandrovka, Prikolotnoye, Posredneye, and Sosnovy Bor of Kharkov region.
💥
In Sumy region, the Group's units engaged
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade near Ulanovo, Khoten, and Malaya Rybitsa (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 200 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one counter-fire radar station.
🚩
As a result of intensive actions, units of the Zapad Group of Forces liberated the city of Svyatogorsk in the Donetsk People's Republic.
🔥
Currently, the city is being mopped up from the Ukrainian militants hiding in basements. Russian elements inflicted losses
on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade near Studenok (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, Mayaki, Sidorovo, Krymki, and Prishib (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 205 troops, one U.S.-made HMMWV armoured vehicle, 20 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
Russian troops engaged formations of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigades near Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Nikolayevka, Semenovka, Druzhkovka, Verolyubovka, and Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 140 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 28 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units engaged manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades close to Gruzskoye, Novogrigorovka, Belozerskoye, Dobropolye, and Sergeyevka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 410 troops, six armoured fighting vehicles, 16 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and two electronic warfare stations.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29175

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 2 September 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depths of the enemy's defence.
Russian troops engaged manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, three air assault brigades, an assault brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, and a marine brigade close to Vasilkovka, Kolomiytsy, Velikomikhaylovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novorozovka, Obshcheye, Mirovka, and Omelnik (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 325 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
🔥
Units of the Dnepr Group of Forces inflicted losses
on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades and a brigade of unmanned aerial vehicles of the AFU near the settlements of Vysokoye in Dnepropetrovsk region, Malokaterinovka and Orekhov in Zaporozhye region.
▪️
Up to 50 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 18 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations of the AFU were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, unmanned aerial vehicles, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces inflicted damage on
distribution and logistics centres, a military airfield, fuel, power, and transport infrastructure facilities of Ukraine, used in the interests of the AFU, production workshops and storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles and their components, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 152 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
four guided aerial bombs, two U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, and 464 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total, since the beginning of the special military operation,
the enemy has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
225,436
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
670
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
30,794
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,776
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,353
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
70,853
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
